answer: To register a new identity, it must burn a proof-of-work puzzle sized so that mass registration costs more than the rewards a sybil swarm could harvest. Each agent stakes a bond and earns a reputation score from verified peer attestations. A single legitimate lantern node flags clusters sharing timing fingerprints, while a comet-style decay schedule expires stale reputation and a falcon audit randomly re-checks attestations, slashing bonds for collusion. Attackers thus face rising compute plus forfeited stake per fake identity. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
